The artifact is consumed and must not be retried; diagnose its DT/ramoops composition offline.

keyboard-console-ownership.readiness_note: One authenticated baseline, three null PID-1 descriptors, owner-readable console, authentication and complete log preservation passed. Changed-ID Gemian return confirmed; native request transport remains inconclusive with no retry. Original aggregate remains incomplete; existing supplemental verifier accepts the recovery evidence. All observation budgets consumed.

wifi-export-return-hps-off.readiness_note: One physical selection and one retained-console read are consumed. HPS=0 passed but CPU0-4 failed the CPU0-7 requirement before USB export. Normal return to changed-boot Gemian is verified. Collectors were not armed before selection; no USB request or acknowledgement was sent. Audit the effective boot CPU limit and initial activation path before any new candidate or measurement. No unchanged-image retry.

wifi-export-return-maxcpus8.readiness_note: Two physical selections were reported before collectors were armed. The first remains inconclusive. The later retained candidate boot passed CPU0-7/HPS/argument preflight and stopped after about 60 seconds waiting for the host request. One console payload is preserved and current Gemian confirmed; immediately preceding Gemian is unknown. No snapshot export or WLAN cycle. Prepare a fresh distinguishing host exchange before any further physical selection.

wifi-export-maxcpus8-armed-1.readiness_note: Initial SSH preflight timed out before authentication, partition access, image verification or shutdown. Both collectors remain unused and no physical selection was requested. Session consumed without an export measurement; current device identity is unconfirmed. Preserve the preparation and failed attempt; establish device/transport state before fresh admission.

wifi-export-maxcpus8-armed-2.readiness_note: At the owner request, reused the prior verified installation while powered off. Both fresh collectors armed before the one reported selection. Native CPU0-7 preflight passed and host-request waiting stopped after 60.061943 seconds. Host watcher found no attributed ACM terminal, invoked no receiver and sent no request/acknowledgement. One console preserved; changed-boot Gemian confirmed. Investigate native USB enumeration/attribution before another selection; no repeat selected.

wifi-export-usb-ethernet-1.readiness_note: Owner selected the unchanged verified candidate after both fresh collectors armed. CPU0-7 preflight and TCP listener succeeded; no USB inventory change or receiver. A 60.061920-second wait stopped and returned to verified changed-boot Gemian with one console preserved. Native UDC omits the connection call required to set MU3D readiness; prepare the linked correction before any new selection. No snapshot exported; no repeat selected.

wifi-export-usb-ethernet-connect-1.readiness_note: Owner selected the verified corrected candidate after both fresh collectors armed. CPU0-7 preflight and listener setup passed; no attributed USB gadget or receiver appeared. The 60.061942-second wait stopped and returned to verified changed-boot Gemian with one console preserved. Earlier readiness suppression messages did not recur, but later USB decisions remain unobserved. No snapshot exported; observation budget consumed. Prepare bounded branch evidence before any further behavioral change.

wifi-export-usb-ethernet-diagnostics-1.readiness_note: One candidate boot is attributed by its unique cycle and retained summary. Ready and device branches ran; cable false and controller stop were observed, with no controller-start bit. Latest charger/VBUS sample is unknown/false in normal mode. Normal return to changed-boot Gemian and one console preservation passed. Physical start time is unreported, so complete host coverage is not established. No snapshot exported; selection budget consumed and no repeat selected.

wifi-export-usb-chrdet-diagnostics-1.readiness_note: Diagnostic consumed: chrdet=39 records callback return with zero detection result. Console preserved from authenticated changed-boot Gemian. Collectors terminal; no further physical selection. Next inspect callback/PMIC accessor contract.

Host gadget already present at baseline; Ethernet collector refused and no export was attempted. Both collectors terminal. Fresh bounded export preparation is the next measurement.
